INSERT INTO
( age, monthly_income, daily_internet_hours, smartphone_usage_years, social_media_hours, online_payment_trust_score, tech_savvy_score, monthly_online_orders, monthly_store_visits, avg_online_spend, avg_store_spend, discount_sensitivity, return_frequency, avg_delivery_days, delivery_fee_sensitivity, free_return_importance, product_availability_online, impulse_buying_score, need_touch_feel_score, brand_loyalty_score, environmental_awareness, time_pressure_level, gender, city_tier, shopping_preference ) VALUES ( #{age}, #{monthlyIncome}, #{dailyInternetHours}, #{smartphoneUsageYears}, #{socialMediaHours}, #{onlinePaymentTrustScore}, #{techSavvyScore}, #{monthlyOnlineOrders}, #{monthlyStoreVisits}, #{avgOnlineSpend}, #{avgStoreSpend}, #{discountSensitivity}, #{returnFrequency}, #{avgDeliveryDays}, #{deliveryFeeSensitivity}, #{freeReturnImportance}, #{productAvailabilityOnline}, #{impulseBuyingScore}, #{needTouchFeelScore}, #{brandLoyaltyScore}, #{environmentalAwareness}, #{timePressureLevel}, #{gender}, #{cityTier}, #{shoppingPreference} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE
SET age = #{age}, monthly_income = #{monthlyIncome}, daily_internet_hours = #{dailyInternetHours}, smartphone_usage_years = #{smartphoneUsageYears}, social_media_hours = #{socialMediaHours}, online_payment_trust_score = #{onlinePaymentTrustScore}, tech_savvy_score = #{techSavvyScore}, monthly_online_orders = #{monthlyOnlineOrders}, monthly_store_visits = #{monthlyStoreVisits}, avg_online_spend = #{avgOnlineSpend}, avg_store_spend = #{avgStoreSpend}, discount_sensitivity = #{discountSensitivity}, return_frequency = #{returnFrequency}, avg_delivery_days = #{avgDeliveryDays}, delivery_fee_sensitivity = #{deliveryFeeSensitivity}, free_return_importance = #{freeReturnImportance}, product_availability_online = #{productAvailabilityOnline}, impulse_buying_score = #{impulseBuyingScore}, need_touch_feel_score = #{needTouchFeelScore}, brand_loyalty_score = #{brandLoyaltyScore}, environmental_awareness = #{environmentalAwareness}, time_pressure_level = #{timePressureLevel}, gender = #{gender}, city_tier = #{cityTier}, shopping_preference = #{shoppingPreference} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT gender FROM
WHERE gender IS NOT NULL AND gender != '' ORDER BY gender ASC

SELECT DISTINCT city_tier FROM
WHERE city_tier IS NOT NULL AND city_tier != '' ORDER BY city_tier ASC

SELECT DISTINCT shopping_preference FROM
WHERE shopping_preference IS NOT NULL AND shopping_preference != '' ORDER BY shopping_preference ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(age), 0), 1) AS avgAge, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_income), 0), 2) AS avgIncome, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(daily_internet_hours), 0), 2) AS avgDailyInternetHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(social_media_hours), 0), 2) AS avgSocialMediaHours, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_online_orders), 0), 2) AS avgOnlineOrders, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_store_visits), 0), 2) AS avgStoreVisits, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(avg_online_spend), 0), 2) AS avgOnlineSpend, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(avg_store_spend), 0), 2) AS avgStoreSpend, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(online_payment_trust_score), 0), 2) AS avgPaymentTrustScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(tech_savvy_score), 0), 2) AS avgTechSavvyScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(discount_sensitivity), 0), 2) AS avgDiscountSensitivity, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(brand_loyalty_score), 0), 2) AS avgBrandLoyaltyScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(environmental_awareness), 0), 2) AS avgEnvironmentalAwareness, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(time_pressure_level), 0), 2) AS avgTimePressureLevel, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN shopping_preference IN ('Online', 'Both') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 0), 2) AS onlinePreferenceRate, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN shopping_preference = 'Offline' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 0), 2) AS offlinePreferenceRate, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN shopping_preference = 'Both' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 0), 2) AS bothPreferenceRate FROM

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(shopping_preference, ''), 'Unknown') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(shopping_preference, ''), 'Unknown') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(gender, ''), 'Unknown') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(gender, ''), 'Unknown') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(city_tier, ''), 'Unknown') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(city_tier, ''), 'Unknown') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN age < 20 THEN '20岁以下' WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20-29岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30-39岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40-49岁' WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50-59岁' ELSE '60岁及以上' END AS ageSegment, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN shopping_preference = 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onlineCount, SUM(CASE WHEN shopping_preference = 'Offline' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS offlineCount, SUM(CASE WHEN shopping_preference = 'Both' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bothCount, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN shopping_preference IN ('Online', 'Both') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 0), 2) AS onlineRate, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_income), 0), 2) AS avgIncome, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_online_orders), 0), 2) AS avgOnlineOrders, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_store_visits), 0), 2) AS avgStoreVisits FROM
GROUP BY ageSegment ORDER BY MIN( CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN age < 20 THEN 1 WHEN age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN 2 WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN 3 WHEN age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN 4 WHEN age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN 5 ELSE 6 END ) ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN monthly_income IS NULL THEN '未知' WHEN monthly_income < 5000 THEN '5000以下' WHEN monthly_income >= 5000 AND monthly_income < 8000 THEN '5000-7999' WHEN monthly_income >= 8000 AND monthly_income < 12000 THEN '8000-11999' WHEN monthly_income >= 12000 AND monthly_income < 20000 THEN '12000-19999' ELSE '20000及以上' END AS incomeSegment, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(avg_online_spend), 0), 2) AS avgOnlineSpend, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(avg_store_spend), 0), 2) AS avgStoreSpend, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_online_orders), 0), 2) AS avgOnlineOrders, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_store_visits), 0), 2) AS avgStoreVisits, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN shopping_preference IN ('Online', 'Both') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 0), 2) AS onlineRate FROM
GROUP BY incomeSegment ORDER BY MIN( CASE WHEN monthly_income IS NULL THEN 99 WHEN monthly_income < 5000 THEN 1 WHEN monthly_income >= 5000 AND monthly_income < 8000 THEN 2 WHEN monthly_income >= 8000 AND monthly_income < 12000 THEN 3 WHEN monthly_income >= 12000 AND monthly_income < 20000 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ) ASC

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(city_tier, ''), 'Unknown') AS cityTier, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_income), 0), 2) AS avgIncome, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_online_orders), 0), 2) AS avgOnlineOrders, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_store_visits), 0), 2) AS avgStoreVisits, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(avg_online_spend), 0), 2) AS avgOnlineSpend, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(avg_store_spend), 0), 2) AS avgStoreSpend, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(tech_savvy_score), 0), 2) AS avgTechSavvyScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(discount_sensitivity), 0), 2) AS avgDiscountSensitivity, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(online_payment_trust_score), 0), 2) AS avgPaymentTrustScore, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN shopping_preference IN ('Online', 'Both') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 0), 2) AS onlineRate FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(city_tier, ''), 'Unknown') ORDER BY totalCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(shopping_preference, ''), 'Unknown') AS preference, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(online_payment_trust_score), 0), 2) AS onlinePaymentTrustScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(tech_savvy_score), 0), 2) AS techSavvyScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(discount_sensitivity), 0), 2) AS discountSensitivity, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(return_frequency), 0), 2) AS returnFrequency, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(delivery_fee_sensitivity), 0), 2) AS deliveryFeeSensitivity, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(free_return_importance), 0), 2) AS freeReturnImportance, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(product_availability_online), 0), 2) AS productAvailabilityOnline, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(impulse_buying_score), 0), 2) AS impulseBuyingScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(need_touch_feel_score), 0), 2) AS needTouchFeelScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(brand_loyalty_score), 0), 2) AS brandLoyaltyScore, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(environmental_awareness), 0), 2) AS environmentalAwareness, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(time_pressure_level), 0), 2) AS timePressureLevel, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_online_orders), 0), 2) AS avgOnlineOrders, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(monthly_store_visits), 0), 2) AS avgStoreVisits FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(shopping_preference, ''), 'Unknown') ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(shopping_preference, ''), 'Unknown') AS preference, COUNT(1) AS totalCount, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(avg_delivery_days), 0), 2) AS avgDeliveryDays, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(delivery_fee_sensitivity), 0), 2) AS deliveryFeeSensitivity, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(free_return_importance), 0), 2) AS freeReturnImportance, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(return_frequency), 0), 2) AS returnFrequency, ROUND(IFNULL(AVG(product_availability_online), 0), 2) AS productAvailabilityOnline FROM
GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(shopping_preference, ''), 'Unknown') ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT tech_savvy_score AS techSavvyScore, monthly_online_orders AS monthlyOnlineOrders, monthly_income AS monthlyIncome, avg_online_spend AS avgOnlineSpend, IFNULL(NULLIF(city_tier, ''), 'Unknown') AS cityTier, IFNULL(NULLIF(shopping_preference, ''), 'Unknown') AS shoppingPreference FROM
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 350
